clips.title: The story
paras: Seasoned Wolf Kabobs is an Alliance culinary quest offered by Chef Grual at the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Darkshire. Grual seeks to prepare his signature house dish, tasking adventurers with hunting wild wolves in Duskwood for the meat, while his seasoning herbs arrive by shipment from Stormwind City. It highlights the everyday survival challenges and resourcefulness required to keep a besieged hamlet fed.

Darkshire is an isolated settlement surrounded by the creeping horrors of Duskwood, where trade caravans rarely venture and normal agriculture has completely collapsed. Despite the ever-present gloom and lurking undead, the town's citizens still require sustenance. Chef Grual, presiding over the kitchens of the Scarlet Raven Tavern, makes practical use of the forest's dangerous fauna by transforming wild wolf meat into hearty skewers. Because local timber and soil cannot sustain delicate crops, Grual relies on specialized spices brought in from the capital to make the gamey forest meat palatable.

To complete Grual's recipe, travelers need only secure lean flanks from the ferocious wolves stalking Duskwood. Grual has just received his latest shipment of Stormwind Seasoning Herbs, so the meat is all he lacks. The shipment underscores Darkshire's delicate connection to the broader kingdom: while royal military aid has dwindled, small-scale civic ties and supply lines between the city merchants and outer hamlets still barely endure.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Seasoned Wolf Kabobs are a house favorite! Sure, I can make you some. But first I'll need the supplies. Bring me 10 Lean Wolf Flanks. Given the many wolves here in the forest, I am sure finding the Flanks will be no problem. Fortunately for you, I just received my recent shipment of Stormwind Seasoning Herbs, so all I need are the flanks to get started.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Were you able to find 10 Lean Wolf Flanks yet? How about the herbs from Felicia in Stormwind?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Very nice work, friend! Enjoy the delicacy known as Seasoned Wolf Kabob!
